title: Kingdom Connections: A Directory With Verified Service Reviews
author: Jason Lamb
excerpt: A standalone Christian business directory with owner listings, customer profiles, and reviews tied to manually verified services.

cover.alt: Illustrated neighborhood businesses linked by paths beneath a verified five-star review symbol

content_html:
Kingdom Connections is a directory for Christian businesses and the people looking for their services. Business owners manage listings, descriptions, contact information, and images. Customers can keep profiles and browse those listings.

Its review flow is tied to a completed service. A customer submits a receipt reference, and a super admin checks the merchant's settled payment record before the customer can leave one rating for that service. Verification is manual; the app does not collect card details or claim to process payments.

The project uses its own accounts and storage rather than automatically reusing the website's shared account system. Image uploads are resized and re-encoded, and private storage needs host-level protection and backups.

A demonstration dataset can show fictional businesses, customer accounts, and simulated verified reviews. Those records identify themselves as demo content and are separate from a fresh production installation.
